tone_tokens.spacing: generous (Tailwind p-6, p-8, p-12 for sections)

fabrication_guardrails: DO NOT break the existing proxy of api.makers.fun.
ALL data, numbers, and stats MUST come from the proxied API.
No invented stats, testimonials, or fake metrics.
conversion_wiring: Wallet connect button in header (right-aligned pill).

typography.headline: 'Outfit', sans-serif
typography.accent: 'Playfair Display', serif (use italic for accent words)
typography.monospace: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace (for live stats and crypto numbers)

visual_enhancers.cards: Glassy dark cards (bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-xl) with hairline light borders (border-white/10).
visual_enhancers.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Primary buttons use mint accent.
visual_enhancers.active_states: Glowing mint active states for nav pills and inputs.
visual_enhancers.typography_accents: Use italic serif ('Playfair Display') for specific accent words in headlines (e.g., 'Your *Empire*.').

layouts.hero: Dark cinematic hero with big statement headline, italic serif accents, and live stats overlay.
layouts.tables: Sortable markets-style table for maker desks. Use mono font for data. Glassy container.
layouts.navigation: Top nav with rounded pill active state, right-aligned wallet chip + 'Connect wallet' mint pill button.

motion.hover: Subtle translate-y lift for cards with increased glow.
motion.entrance: Fade in and slide up for table rows and live activity feed.
motion.buttons: Scale up slightly on hover with intensified mint glow.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white and mint text pass contrast against #07111f and #0d1b2a backgrounds.

image_urls.description: Dark cinematic abstract grid texture for hero background layering.
Ethereum dark diamond abstract to be used as a subtle graphic overlay or empty state.

components.buttons: Shadcn based, heavily modified to be pill-shaped (rounded-full), mint background for primary (#8AF5D0 text-[#07111f]).
components.cards: Shadcn based, flat with transparent/glassy backgrounds and thin border-white/10.
components.tables: Shadcn tables, transparent rows, mono font numbers, red/green for price changes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a dark cinematic 'empire' theme. Overwrite the previous makers cream theme. The background is a deep navy-black (#07111f). Use white for headings and mint (#8AF5D0) for primary buttons/accents. Mix 'Outfit' for most text with 'Playfair Display' (italic) for emphasis in large headings, and 'JetBrains Mono' for all numerical data. Use pill-shapes (rounded-full) for buttons and glassy cards (rounded-xl, border-white/10). Maintain 100% of the existing proxy API logic to api.makers.fun—do not invent data. All components must have data-testid attributes for testing.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use dark colors as gradients.
Avoid generic centered layouts. Use depth through layered design elements and glass-morphism.
Do NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all).
Do NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc. for icons.
Use Phosphor Icons or Lucide React for crisp, technical iconography.
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive and key informational elements.
